diagnosis: Highly saturated shallow pigment is exposed by the shader as planar reflection fades near contact. It is the strongest causal candidate for cyan/green rims; same-camera A/B remains required.
sourceEvidence: FoamColor is near cream (.992,1,.906), not saturated cyan. No emissive color/property in the water shader.
Caustics add warm bed light with max strength .22 and fade in .03-.16m; they are a secondary candidate only if shallow-color A/B fails.
NatureBuilder copies the meadow water material and overrides only _ShoreStrength=.42 and _ShoreWidth=.11.
WatersideMood caches four palette colors in transient daylight and renderer property blocks; the editor-only Apply refreshes only shallow MPB and resets that transient snapshot.

integration.preconditions: V2 active; edit mode; compilation complete; Mood Day restored from previous capture
integration.protection: No scene saves/reloads, no global shader or meadow water edits, no reflection/interaction MPB clearing.
